About Me

Self-taught programmer who builds games, desktop tools and home-server software for the pleasure of solving the problem in front of me. No client briefs, no tickets — just a problem I find interesting and a blank project folder.

I care about architecture that holds up months later, root-cause fixes over workarounds, and the small interface details nobody notices until they're missing. My projects land in four areas — games, desktop tools, mobile apps, and home infrastructure — and the approach stays the same across all of them.
